answer: Sybil resistance binds identity to sustained physical expenditure, not a registrable name: each newcomer stakes a sealed quartz oscillator whose ageing drift is measured continuously, so ten thousand forged identities multiply ongoing cost, not one-time paperwork. Attestations pass a shared inlet fingerprinting each stake's noise, and standing accrues only along unbroken measured histories, so clones arrive empty and slide off like a lotus leaf.
